scope: All selected story and closing-theme CGs; figure scale, visible identity and stage. This complements sprite framing and location continuity.
authority_note: Wiki descriptions establish physical identity and family age order. Relative pixel heights are a shared production guide, not new canonical centimetres or event ages.

relations: Cali and Cassia have near-equal stature within each childhood stage.
Joren is modestly taller, about five percent in the shared production layout.
Kael is the larger older sibling; Lyra is distinctly smaller.
Parents remain adults with their individual builds, including petite Selene.
Use visible skull/body/limb maturity and the actual support plane; do not explain an unsupported size reversal away as perspective.

review_policy.hash_rule: Changed selected pixels, character references or the shared layout contract invalidate the prior CG visual review.
review_policy.limit: The guard enforces explicit review of current inputs. It cannot measure a painted child's anatomical stature or automatically judge its artistic consistency.

specs: Chestnut curls/waves; deep blue eyes; light olive skin and freckles.
A comparable-height peer of Cassia; younger than Kael, older than Lyra.
Later-childhood proportions have longer limbs and less round facial structure than early play; no fixed event age is invented.
Rich umber skin, long wavy chestnut hair, deep green eyes.
Slender build and near-equal peer stature to Cali; preserve detailed midtones and soft lip shading.
Fair ruddy skin, tousled blond hair, blue eyes and energetic child expression.
Modestly taller than Cali/Cassia at the same stage; do not create that difference by enlarging only his head.
Deep warm brown skin, dark tousled hair, hazel eyes with a gold emphasis.
Older brother, visibly taller and more solidly framed than Cali and the peer group.
Golden-tan skin with olive undertones and golden freckles; golden-blonde curls; green eyes.
Younger, distinctly smaller sibling, with shorter torso and limbs.
Adult, tall/slender, warm brown skin, curly hair with small braids; amber eyes flecked green.
Preserve adult torso/hands; distinguish newborn-era and later family context without inventing exact parental ages.
Petite adult, deep bronze skin, pure white hair and violet eyes.
White hair is genetic; retain adult body proportions without turning her into an elderly person.
Adult, pale freckled skin, short auburn hair, blue eyes; androgynous appearance and capable forearms.
Do not assign an unsupported injury date to the newborn-era image.
Adult, rich dark skin, brown eyes, glasses, broad shoulders and mixed dark/gray hair.
Newborn-era hair/beard need not inherit all late-life silver.
Adult, warm tan freckled skin, soft androgynous features, short sandy hair and gray eyes.
Author-approved fluffy black-and-white rat with white blaze, large pink ears, violet viewer-left and coral viewer-right eyes in frontal view.
Small enough for the depicted cupped hands; smaller than Shadow, who is smaller than Barkley.
